plan_point: 77.44.7.D / D-06 structured gallery and carousel accessibility
scope: Bounded structured gallery/carousel landmark-name improvement; not full D-06 or full Editor acceptance.

change.behavior: Structured galleries and carousels now render as named ARIA regions in the Editor canvas and published renderer. A separate Inspector field stores an optional bounded ariaLabel on node props, outside contentModel. The renderer escapes authored labels, bounds them to 160 characters, rejects non-string legacy values without coercion, and preserves Hungarian fallback labels for older pages. Save and Publish remain separate.
change.reused_project_code: The existing structured renderer normalization/escaping and existing Inspector Page Model updateProperties command route; no second content model, renderer or update path.
change.open_source_review: No external package/code was needed: the existing project renderer, sanitizer and command contract fit this narrow change. No dependency added; no copied external source or license obligations introduced.
change.save_publish: The new label is a draft node property; Save persists it without publishing, reload restores the draft, and only a separate Publish changes the public renderer.
